about.heading: Tech news, engineered.
about.subheading: TechPulse is an independent technology magazine for people who build, secure and ship modern software. We cover the products, platforms and people shaping the industry.

values.title: Signal over noise
values.body: We publish fewer, better stories: every piece earns its place by explaining what changed, why it matters and what happens next.

values.title: Independent by design
values.body: No sponsored rankings, no pay-to-play coverage. Our only leverage is the trust of readers who build the future.

values.title: Craft in every paragraph
values.body: Every story is reported, edited and fact-checked by a human editor before it reaches the front page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: TechPulse Magazine respects your privacy. This page explains what data we process when you read our stories or create an account, and how you stay in control of it.
privacy.dataBody: When you sign in with Google we receive your name, email address and profile picture. Reading stories requires no account and stores no personal data.
privacy.cookiesBody: Your session is signed and stored in a JWT cookie: the newsroom keeps no password and no user database. The payment simulator only drops a Premium marker for display.
privacy.retentionBody: The session cookie expires when you sign out. The demo Premium marker expires after thirty days and you can clear it at any time.
privacy.rightsBody: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of the data linked to your account. Write to us: we answer within thirty days.
privacy.contactBody: A question about your data, or want to exercise your rights? The newsroom answers you directly.
privacy.cardBody: What we do with your data

terms.title: Legal notice & terms
terms.intro: TechPulse Magazine is an independent tech publication. This page states who publishes the site, how it is hosted, what you may do with our content and the terms governing reader accounts and the demo Premium subscription.
terms.publisherBody: TechPulse Magazine is published by the TechPulse newsroom. Publication director: the TechPulse editorial team. Reach us at any time through the contact page.
terms.hostingBody: The magazine is served by Vercel Inc.; editorial content comes from a headless WordPress CMS hosted on Pantheon.
terms.ipBody: Articles, artwork and logos remain the property of their authors. Any reproduction, even partial, requires attribution and prior agreement.
terms.accountBody: Reader accounts rely on Google sign-in: the magazine keeps no user database. You can sign out at any time from your dashboard.
terms.subscriptionBody: The Premium subscription is simulated: no real payment is collected and the Premium status is only stored in a demo cookie marker.
terms.liabilityBody: Content is provided for information purposes only. TechPulse cannot be held liable for indirect damages arising from its use, nor for temporary service unavailability.
terms.lawBody: This legal notice is governed by French law. For any dispute, contact the newsroom first: we always look for an amicable solution.
terms.contactBody: For any question about this notice, your data or your rights, write to us: the newsroom answers directly.
